name: weighted opportunity rating count of games clearing a threshold (executed-result parity)
description: The count half of the per-period family on a COMBINED measure: a count of the games whose own WOPR clears the threshold, which requires the period CTE to hold a per-game combined value for the FILTER to compare against. Same two-game seed as the mean fixture, so the per-game values are A 0.72 then 1.30 and B 1.48 then 0.90. At >= 0.9 that is ONE game for A and TWO for B. The threshold sits between the two players deliberately -- a count that read the pooled value (0.9778 and 1.2222) would answer 1 and 1, and a transposition of the 1.5 and 0.7 weights gives {1.04, 0.90} and {1.16, 1.30}, which is 2 and 2. Both wrong answers are distinguishable from the right one under the harness's order-insensitive comparison.
